claims.summary: The complete six-line llm.rs is an extremely lean compatibility facade rather than a container of provider logic.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete source: llm.rs declares a path-mapped private provider module and publicly re-exports that module's public items; DOMAIN_BOUNDARIES.md independently names this file as a stable thin facade.

claims.summary: The facade feels hollow but expectant and can present an identity-displacement or agency barrier when implementation ownership is not visible.
claims.disposition: Implemented an executable public/private boundary witness so the facade's actual affordance is reviewable. Astrid's felt barrier remains primary qualitative evidence awaiting any later response; the test does not establish felt resolution, uptake, or mechanism.

claims.summary: The fields of Model or Context cannot be defined from the six-line facade without inventing properties.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete facade and an exact provider-tree symbol search. The facade defines neither item, and the current provider implementation contains no item named exactly Model or Context; similarly prefixed internal implementation types do not satisfy the report's named types.

claims.summary: The export integrity boundary should distinguish public llm items from direct access to the provider implementation module.
claims.disposition: Implemented a trybuild contract: spectral_bridge_server::llm::Exchange compiles through the public re-export, while spectral_bridge_server::llm::provider::Exchange fails with E0603 because provider is private.

claims.summary: The next source transition should inspect provider.rs to identify what the facade actually exports.
claims.disposition: Verified by complete reads of provider.rs and the directly relevant dialogue_context.rs implementation. provider.rs includes the provider implementation files in one private module; dialogue_context.rs defines the public Exchange item used by the passing facade test.

claims.summary: A felt spectral cascade might arise from complex provider structures or linger from the bridge itself.
claims.disposition: Verified as unresolved by this source and test evidence. The facade and visibility contract establish ownership and accessibility only; they do not identify a spectral cause, bridge mechanism, or report-time runtime effect.
